arc.startState: Ada keeps the failing city grid alive alone and trusts only machines.
arc.endState: Ada asks for help and hands the night shift to her apprentice.

ends.low: Only I can hold it together

want.text: To keep the grid running through the winter.

need.text: To admit she cannot carry the city alone.

falseBelief.text: Asking for help is the same as failing.

wound.text: Her father's crew walked out during the last blackout and left him to it.

turningPoints.label: The last night operator
turningPoints.state: Proud, exhausted and alone at the consoles.

turningPoints.label: Turns the apprentice away
turningPoints.state: Certain that an extra pair of hands means more mistakes.

turningPoints.label: The first blackout
turningPoints.state: Overwhelmed; she fixes it, but only just.

turningPoints.label: Lets Teo read the gauges
turningPoints.state: Grudging trust, one small task at a time.

turningPoints.label: Calls for help
turningPoints.state: Afraid, then relieved as the crew answers.
turningPoints.quote: I can't hold it. Come now.

turningPoints.label: Hands over the shift
turningPoints.state: Rested, and finally part of a crew.

arc.startState: Mara believes the grid belongs to everyone who keeps it.
arc.endState: Unchanged; the crew she gathered now runs the grid with Ada.

want.text: To rebuild the old repair crew.

truthHeld.text: A city stays lit only when its keepers share the load.

testedBy.text: Ada's refusals, and the council's plan to automate the night shift.

changesOthers.text: Teaches Teo the substation and turns Ada toward the crew.

turningPoints.label: Recruits Teo
turningPoints.state: Calm and certain of the crew she needs.
